Which Sudanese military officer seized power in a 1989 coup as a brigadier general, ruled for three decades, then was deposed in 2019 and jailed for corruption?

Omar al-Bashir (born 1 January 1944) is a Sudanese former military officer and politician who served as head of state of Sudan under various titles from 1989 until 2019, when he was deposed in a coup d'tat.
This genus of anaerobic, Gram-positive bacteria found in soil and animal intestines includes the microbes responsible for both botulism and tetanus — which genus?
Clostridium: Genus of bacteria. Species of Clostridium inhabit soils and the intestinal tracts of animals, including humans.
In which country is National League (English football)?
National League (English football): United Kingdom. The National League is one of the major professional sports leagues in England and is the highest tier of Non-League football in England.
